premises.name: account01/B15 principal 3/4 block theorem
premises.scope: uniform affine density bound C3/kappa or C4/kappa on a fixed invertible physical principal block; every rank>=3 symmetric matrix has such a block of order 3 or4

new_results.statement: If coordinate j has a disjoint invertible physical principal 3/4-block I_j with H_j=C_|I_j|/sigma_min(A[I_j,I_j]), then changing only marginal j changes the quadratic-output density by at most H_j times the L1 distance of that marginal. If every j has such a block, telescope to sum_j H_j||f_j-g_j||_1.
For every fixed real symmetric A with rank(A)>=5 and every independent cap-one measurable input densities, X^TAX has a C0(R) density. More generally it suffices that rank(A[j^c,j^c])>=3 for every j.

For every rank>=3 symmetric A, choose one invertible physical principal block I of order 3 or4. All marginals outside I can be smoothed with output-Linfinity convergence while keeping the core marginals fixed, so the remaining rough-input continuity obstruction is confined to at most four physical marginals.

unresolved_implication: Full universal matrix- and dimension-independent Linfinity bound remains open. Separately, rough-input continuity remains to be closed in the rank-3/rank-4 core-marginal cases or refuted by a valid independent product-law example.
next_step: For regularity, derive an L1-to-Linfinity replacement estimate for a core marginal when all available invertible principal 3/4 blocks contain it, perhaps by two-stage conditioning or pair-log smoothing; otherwise seek a genuine rank-3/rank-4 product-law discontinuity. Do not use the matrix-dependent H_j constants as a universal-height argument.
